results.label: curb_failure
results.note: delivery bot gets stuck on a curb, Palisades Park, Santa Monica

visual_evidence: 00:08-00:10: The robot reverses from the bike lane onto a raised concrete curb bordering the park path, getting its rear wheels up on the curb while the front wheels remain below, becoming high-centered and stuck.
00:18-00:21: The robot's motors hum and the chassis twitches slightly as it attempts to move, but it remains immobilized on the curb.
00:35-00:48: The bystander notes 'Coco stuck' while the robot remains wedged on the curb in the same position.
00:50-00:55: The bystander physically lifts and pushes the robot off the curb back onto the bike lane so it can resume driving.

03:54: Crossfade transition at the intersection.
04:29-04:36: Abrupt zoom-in and zoom-out on the rear of the robot.
05:40: Crossfade transition to the channel outro on the beach.
